info.title: Policy rehearsal engine
info.description: Policy PDF → PolicyIR → Person 3 fuzz (≤50 agents) + optional MiroFish swarm → EvaluationReport + PolicyEffectivenessReport (0–100).

schema.title: Response List Runs V1 Runs Get

post.description: Rebuild the MiroFish seed/prompt. Pass launch=true to POST into a running MiroFish.
Person 3: grade fuzz agents and optionally run the MiroFish swarm, then score 0–100.

get.description: JSON Schema handoff for the frontend and other roles.
Zip of engine/docs — send this file to the frontend developer.

ActionSpec.title: ActionSpec
ActionSpec.description: An action a scenario may attempt (use_phone, confiscate, appeal, ...).

AgentInteraction.title: AgentInteraction
AgentInteraction.description: One notable swarm moment used to justify the score.

AttributeSchema.title: AttributeSchema
AttributeSchema.description: Typed field person 3 should fill when synthesizing a scenario fact.

AudienceSegment.title: AudienceSegment
AudienceSegment.description: One injectable audience slice (not tied to any jurisdiction).

policy_text.title: Policy Text
policy_text.description: Paste a policy if you are not uploading a file

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: Optional locale / jurisdiction label for the audience

seed_file.title: Seed File
seed_file.description: Optional audience seed PDF/TXT/MD. Text is merged into seed_text.

Citation.title: Citation
Citation.description: Pointer back to the source document. Quotes must be verbatim.

CompiledIndex.title: CompiledIndex
CompiledIndex.description: Derived lookup tables. Rebuilt on every compile — do not edit by hand.

EvaluationReport.title: EvaluationReport
EvaluationReport.description: Person 4 output. Integration stores it if an evaluator plugin is registered.

MiroFishPack.title: MiroFishPack
MiroFishPack.description: Handoff from this engine to MiroFish: a population seed + sim prompt.

PolicyEffectivenessReport.title: PolicyEffectivenessReport
PolicyEffectivenessReport.description: 0–100 score of how well the inputted policy would work, plus why.

PolicyIR.title: PolicyIR
PolicyIR.description: Compiled policy. This is the handoff from person 2 to person 3.

Predicate.title: Predicate
Predicate.description:
Atomic condition, evaluable against scenario.facts.

`field` uses dotted paths into the scenario fact bag, for example:
  actor.role, actor.grade, action.name, context.location, context.time

RevisionHint.title: RevisionHint
RevisionHint.description: Smallest useful change for Person 2's repair agent / the human editor.

Scenario.title: Scenario
Scenario.description:
One test case against PolicyIR.

`facts` must be fillable from PolicyIR.actor_types / actions / index.fact_fields
so person 4 can evaluate predicates without extra interpretation.

SeedSpec.title: SeedSpec
SeedSpec.description:
Population / personality seed for person 3.

Integration stores this with the run. Person 3 reads it from GET /v1/runs/{id}.
Prefer `segments` for structured audience injection; `text` remains freeform notes
for MiroFish prose. `groups` is a shorthand that still works without segments.
